g.text: So, what's the situation with the metal cranes you make?
Would you be willing to make me a metal crane?
they're pretty! and fun! most importantly...
I suppoooose I would, but they're really for me ;)
You seem upset. Is it something I said?
I thought that was for *paper* cranes.
What? Where did you hear that?
oh yes but *metal* cranes are even more magical (I like to think)
I thought it was common knowledge!
I didn't love being called boring.
I've never heard that in my life.
First I'm hearing of this. I'd love to know more.
Actually, come to think of it, I think I did hear that once.
That doesn't sound real, but if it makes you happy, that's cool.
Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
I'm sure! cranes have a proven track record, u know
wasn't too ridiculous for the Jipangu space program!
then allow me to fill u in ^_^
before Jipangu trained their astronauts to go to space, they had candidates fold 1000 cranes. true story!
it's just what it sounds like! when u fold 1000 cranes, ur supposed to get a wish. traditionally, people fold paper, but I'm sure folding metal works just as well lol
allow me to grant ur wish ;)
oh excellent! who couldn't use a wish, right? it's a lovely notion
So, how many have you folded by now?
I've seen you fold a lot. Have you gotten to 1000 before?
Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
I doubt that was because of some superstition. They were probably just testing concentration or something like that.
Ah, interesting. Skill-testing and luck-building all in one. Very wise.
a few hundred. I have a tally tucked away somewhere between all my CDs lol
actually yes! that wish wasn't for me though. time I get a wish for myself, dontcha think?
It seems the jury's convinced by your defense
How do you not have a precise number? I thought you'd have that memorized haha
Oh yeah? What lucky someone got that wish?
and grants you a fresh start
no way! focusing on the end is just overwhelming. the trick is to focus on the moment. one step at a time! then one day u look around and go "oh look at that I'm done" ^_^
if I tell u, it won't come tru!
weeeell it's not a very cheery tale. I'd rather not get into it right now.
cranes don't have to be metal. go on, start folding that paper! ^_^ or metal, if u prefer! (tho I think u'll find that much harder)
I don't mean that as a bad thing.
Ah, so you're pacing yourself. I guess I can see how raw numbers can take away from the creativity.
My mistake! I should have thought of that. Be sure not to tell me!
I don't think that rule applies to wishes made of metal and paper.
Oh. Hey, I'm sorry to hear that.
Are you sure? I'd really like to hear it.
But I want YOU to make my cranes.
Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
so like did u just ask about my cranes to make fun of me ooor... ?
gosh my whole "these cranes are a deeply personal symbol of growth for me and take a heck of a lot of time to make" thing went right over ur head, huh?
I couldn't have said it better! ^_^
well, the good news is when u fold ur 1000 cranes, u can track them however u want!
ok! I do love a wish guardian ^_^
This next wish will be better anyway :P
Whatever happened, I think it's cool that you're making a wish for yourself. Turning it into something happy.
I just thought that time might be better spent on me.
Oh... Okay, yes it did. My bad.
I think I'm beginning to understand you a lot better.
I'm just glad you're doing what makes you happy.
Next time I see you folding those cranes, I'll have a whole new appreciation.
I've gotta run, but I'll be sending you energy for all that crane-folding.
if this is a joke, I don't find it very funny
nah I just wear cool shades
^_^ ur making my heart feel very full
and next time I see you seeing me fold cranes, I'll have an appreciation for ur appreciation heehee
wow! I can feel ur energy flowing through the cosmos already <3
Hey, I appreciate you telling me about your cranes.
hey, it was cool of u to show interest :)
